#PHASE 1:
#THIS CHUNK BASICALLY COLLECTS USERS INFORMATION AND CALCULATE THE BMI OF THE USER, USING THE INFORMATIONS ENTERED BY THE USER


```{r}

# MYWEIGHT - BMI & GOAL PLANNER



# 1. GET USER INFORMATION
#readline is used y developr to read an input line by line, execute it one line after another. 
#as.numeric is used to convert data or objects to numbrs


name = readline("Enter your name: ")

age = as.numeric(
  readline("Enter your age: ")
)

weight = as.numeric(
  readline("Enter your current weight in kg: ")
)

height_feet = as.numeric(
  readline("Enter your height in feet: ")
)

height_inches = as.numeric(
  readline("Enter the remaining inches: ")
)

#NEXT; calculate BMI

calculate_bmi = function(weight, height_feet, height_inches) {
  
# Convert feet to metres

feet_m = height_feet * 0.3048
  
# Convert inches to metres

inches_m = height_inches * 0.0254

  
# Total height in metres

height_m = feet_m + inches_m

  
# Calculate BMI

bmi <- weight / (height_m^2)
  
  return(bmi)
}


bmi =  calculate_bmi(
  weight,
  height_feet,
  height_inches
)


#  DETERMINE BMI CATEGORY


if (bmi < 18.5) {
  
  category = "Underweight"
  
} else if (bmi < 25) {
  
  category = "Normal weight"
  
} else if (bmi < 30) {
  
  category = "Overweight"
  
} else {
  
  category = "Obesity"
  
}


# 4. DISPLAY BMI RESULT

cat("\n")

cat("==============================\n")

cat("        MYWEIGHT RESULT       \n")

cat("==============================\n")

cat("Hello", name, "!\n")
cat("Age:", age, "\n")
cat("Current weight:", weight, "kg\n")
cat("Your BMI:", round(bmi, 2), "\n")
cat("BMI Category:", category, "\n")

cat("==============================\n")


# 5. RECOMMEND AN ACTION


if (category == "Underweight") {
  
  cat("\n")
  cat("MyWeight recommends considering a weight-gain plan.\n")
  
  plan_choice <- readline(
    "Would you like to create a weight-gain plan? (yes/no): "
  )
  
  
} else if (category == "Normal weight") {
  
  cat("\n")
  cat("Your BMI is currently within the normal range.\n")
  
  cat("MyWeight recommends monitoring your weight over time.\n")
  
  
  plan_choice = readline(
    "Would you like to set a personal weight goal anyway? (yes/no): "
  )
  
  
} else {
  
  cat("\n")
  cat("MyWeight recommends considering a weight-management plan.\n")
  
  plan_choice = readline(
    "Would you like to create a weight-management plan? (yes/no): "
  )
  
}


# 6. ASK FOR TARGET WEIGHT

#tolower() is used to make upper case letters turn to lower case. Knowing R is case sesitive, YES entered by user will not work so tolower() converts users input incase of uppercase to lowercase



if (tolower(plan_choice) == "yes") {
  
  target_weight = as.numeric(
    readline("Enter your target weight in kg: ")
  )
  

# 7. CALCULATE WEIGHT CHANGE

  
calculate_weight_change = function(current_weight, target_weight)
  {
    
weight_change = target_weight - current_weight
    
    
    if (weight_change < 0) {
      
      type = "Weight loss"
      amount = abs(weight_change)
      
    } else if (weight_change > 0) {
      
      type = "Weight gain"
      amount = weight_change
      
    } else {
      
      type = "No change"
      amount = 0
    }
    
    
    return(list(
      type = type,
      amount = amount
    ))
  }
  
  
# Run the function
  
  result = calculate_weight_change(
    weight,
    target_weight
  )
  
  
# 8. DISPLAY GOAL

  
  cat("\n")
  cat("==============================\n")
  cat("        YOUR GOAL             \n")
  cat("==============================\n")
  
  cat("Goal:", result$type, "\n")
  cat("Amount:", result$amount, "kg\n")
  cat("Target weight:", target_weight, "kg\n")
  
  cat("==============================\n")
  
  
} else {
  
  cat("\n")
  cat("No goal created.\n")
  cat("You can create a plan later.\n")
  
}
```


#PHASE 2;

```{r}
# PHASE 2:
# THIS CHUNK CREATES THE USER'S WEIGHT PLAN
# BASED ON THE GOAL CREATED IN PHASE 1


# 1. ASK FOR THE NUMBER OF MONTHS

months = as.numeric(
  readline("How many months do you want to achieve your goal? ")
)


# 2. SET THE MAXIMUM NUMBER OF MONTHS

if (result$type == "Weight loss") {
  
  max_months = 12
  
} else if (result$type == "Weight gain") {
  
  max_months = 6
  
}


# 3. CHECK IF THE NUMBER OF MONTHS IS VALID

if (months < 1) 
  {
  
cat("Your plan must be at least 1 month.\n")
  
} else if (months > max_months) 
  {
  
  cat(
    "Your plan cannot exceed",
    max_months,
    "months for",
    result$type,
    ".\n"
  )
  
} else {
  
  cat(
    "Your",    result$type,     "plan will run for",    months,    "months.\n"
  )
  
}


# 4. CREATE MONTHLY TARGETS


if (months >= 1 && months <= max_months) {
  
monthly_targets = seq(from = weight, to = target_weight,    length.out = months + 1 )
  
monthly_targets
}

plan = data.frame(  Month = 0:months, Target_Weight = monthly_targets)

plan


```
```{r}
# PHASE 3:
# THIS CHUNK TRACKS THE USER'S ACTUAL WEIGHT
# AND COMPARES IT WITH THEIR MONTHLY TARGET


# 1. ASK WHICH MONTH THE USER IS CHECKING

current_month = as.numeric(  readline("Which month are you currently checking?"))


# 2. CHECK THAT THE MONTH IS VALID

if (current_month < 1 || current_month > months) {
  
  cat("Invalid month. Please enter a month between 1 and", months, ".\n")
  
} else {
  
  cat("You are checking Month", current_month, ".\n")
  
}

# 3. GET THE TARGET WEIGHT FOR THAT MONTH

target_for_month = plan$Target_Weight[current_month + 1]

cat("Your target weight for Month", current_month,  "is", round(target_for_month, 2),  "kg.\n")

# 4. GET CURRENT WEIGHT

actual_weight = as.numeric(readline("Enter your current weight in kg: "))


# 5. COMPARE ACTUAL WEIGHT WITH TARGET

difference = actual_weight - target_for_month

cat(  "Difference from target:",round(abs(difference), 2),  "kg.\n")


# 6. EVALUATE THE USER'S PROGRESS

if (result$type == "Weight loss") {
  
  if (actual_weight <= target_for_month) {
    
    cat("\n")
    cat("Great job, ", name, "!\n")
    cat("You have met your target for Month ", current_month, ".\n", sep = "")
    cat("Keep up the good work!\n")
    
  } else {
    
    cat("\n")
    cat("You're making progress, ", name, "!\n")
    cat("You are", round(actual_weight - target_for_month, 2), "kg above your target for this month.\n")
    
    cat("Don't be discouraged. Keep working toward your goal.\n")
  }
  
  
} else if (result$type == "Weight gain") {
  
  if (actual_weight >= target_for_month) {
    
    cat("\n")
    cat("Great job, ", name, "!\n")
    cat("You have met your target for Month ", current_month, ".\n", sep = "")
    cat("Keep up the good work!\n")
    
  } else {
    
    cat("\n")
    cat("Keep going, ", name, "!\n")
    cat("You are",round(target_for_month - actual_weight, 2), "kg below your target for this month.\n"  )
    cat("You still have time to work toward your goal.\n")
  }
}
```


#phase 4

```{r}
# PHASE 4:
# THIS CHUNK STORES THE USER'S WEIGHT PROGRESS


# 1. DETERMINE THE STATUS OF THE MONTH

if (result$type == "Weight loss") {
  
if (actual_weight <= target_for_month) {
    
status = "Target met"
    
  } else
    {
    
    status = "Not yet met"
    
  }
  
  
} else if (result$type == "Weight gain") {
  
  if (actual_weight >= target_for_month) {
    
    status = "Target met"
    
  } else {
    
    status = "Not yet met"
    
  }
}


# 2. CALCULATE THE DIFFERENCE

difference = actual_weight - target_for_month


# 3. CREATE A RECORD FOR THIS MONTH

progress_record = data.frame(
  
  Month = current_month,
  
  Target_Weight = target_for_month,
  
  Actual_Weight = actual_weight,
  
  Difference = difference,
  
  Status = status
  
)



# 4. DISPLAY THE RECORD

cat("\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("       PROGRESS RECORD        \n")
cat("==============================\n")

cat("Month:", progress_record$Month, "\n")
cat("Target Weight:", progress_record$Target_Weight, "kg\n")
cat("Actual Weight:", progress_record$Actual_Weight, "kg\n")
cat("Difference:", progress_record$Difference, "kg\n")
cat("Status:", progress_record$Status, "\n")

cat("==============================\n")



# 5. CREATE THE PROGRESS HISTORY

progress_history = progress_record

cat("\n")
cat("==============================\n")
cat("       PROGRESS HISTORY       \n")
cat("==============================\n")

cat("Month:", progress_history$Month, "\n")
cat("Target Weight:", progress_history$Target_Weight, "kg\n")
cat("Actual Weight:", progress_history$Actual_Weight, "kg\n")
cat("Difference:", progress_history$Difference, "kg\n")
cat("Status:", progress_history$Status, "\n")

cat("==============================\n")
```

```{r}
# CREATE / CONNECT TO THE MYWEIGHT DATABASE

# CREATE THE USERS TABLE
```

#phase 6
```{r}
# PHASE 6:
# THIS CHUNK STORES THE USER'S INFORMATION
# IN THE MYWEIGHT DATABASE


user_data = data.frame(name = name,age = age, weight = weight,height_feet = height_feet, height_inches = height_inches, bmi = bmi,bmi_category = category)

user_data

myweight_db = dbConnect(
  SQLite(),
  "myweight.db"
)
```

#PHASE 9

```{r}
# PHASE 9:
# RETRIEVE THE RECORDS FOR ONE SPECIFIC PLAN

user_records = dbGetQuery(myweight_db, "SELECT u.user_id, u.name, u.age, u.weight AS starting_weight, u.bmi, u.bmi_category, p.plan_id, p.goal_type, p.target_weight AS final_target_weight, p.duration_months, pr.month, pr.target_weight AS monthly_target, pr.actual_weight,  pr.difference,  pr.status

  FROM users AS u

  INNER JOIN plans AS p
    ON u.user_id = p.user_id

  LEFT JOIN progress AS pr
    ON p.plan_id = pr.plan_id

  WHERE u.user_id = 1

  ORDER BY pr.month ASC  ")

print(user_records)


```
#PHASE 10
```{r}
# PHASE 10:
# CHECK WHETHER THE CURRENT MONTH
# HAS ALREADY BEEN RECORDED


existing_progress = dbGetQuery(myweight_db,  "SELECT *FROM progress
WHERE plan_id = 1
    AND month = ?
  ",
  params = list(current_month)
)


if (nrow(existing_progress) > 0) {

  cat("Progress for this month has already been recorded.\n")

} else {

  cat("This month has not been recorded yet.\n")
}



# SAVE PROGRESS ONLY IF IT HAS NOT BEEN RECORDED


if (nrow(existing_progress) > 0) {

  cat("Progress for this month already exists.\n")
  
  cat("No duplicate record was saved.\n")

} else {

  dbExecute(
    myweight_db,
    "
    INSERT INTO progress (
      plan_id,
      month,
      target_weight,
      actual_weight,
      difference,
      status
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ",
    params = list(
      1,
      current_month,
      target_for_month,
      actual_weight,
      difference,
      status
    )
  )

  cat("Your progress has been saved successfully.\n")
}
```

#PHASE 11
```{r}
# PHASE 11:
# RETRIEVE THE USER'S COMPLETE PROGRESS HISTORY


progress_history = dbGetQuery(
  myweight_db,
  "
  SELECT
    month,
    target_weight,
    actual_weight,
    difference,
    status
  FROM progress
  WHERE plan_id = 1
  ORDER BY month ASC
  "
)


progress_history



# DISPLAY THE PROGRESS HISTORY


if (nrow(progress_history) == 0) {

  cat("No progress records found yet.\n")

} else {

  cat("\nYOUR WEIGHT PROGRESS HISTORY\n\n")

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(progress_history))) {

    cat("Month:", progress_history$month[i], "\n")

    cat(
      "Target weight:",
      progress_history$target_weight[i],
      "kg\n"
    )

    cat(
      "Actual weight:",
      progress_history$actual_weight[i],
      "kg\n"
    )

    cat(
      "Difference:",
      progress_history$difference[i],
      "kg\n"
    )

    cat(
      "Status:",
      progress_history$status[i],
      "\n"
    )

    cat("\n------------------------------\n")
  }
}
```

#PHASE 12
```{r}
# LOAD THE GRAPHING PACKAGE

library(ggplot2)

# CREATE A GRAPH OF ACTUAL WEIGHT VS TARGET WEIGHT

if (nrow(progress_history) > 0) {

  ggplot(progress_history, aes(x = month)) +

    geom_line(
      aes(y = target_weight, color = "Target weight"),
      linewidth = 1
    ) +

    geom_point(
      aes(y = target_weight, color = "Target weight"),
      size = 3
    ) +

    geom_line(
      aes(y = actual_weight, color = "Actual weight"),
      linewidth = 1
    ) +

    geom_point(
      aes(y = actual_weight, color = "Actual weight"),
      size = 3
    ) +

    labs(
      title = "MyWeight Progress Tracker",
      x = "Month",
      y = "Weight (kg)",
      color = "Measurement"
    ) +

    theme_minimal()

} else {

  cat("Record your progress to see your graph.\n")

}
```
